# Independent audit of full-active exclusion and a noncentral row obstruction

Sources:

- `candidate f9d097c4c244eb84`;
- `candidate 45ebdc1c31203276`.



For the exclusion theorem, full-cut statuses are already handled by the precise positive-row regularity source. A nonzero row retaining at least two zeros has zero capacity, so a small transfer of one positive entry from it to a proper full row strictly improves the objective. All remaining nonfull active rows therefore have exactly one zero. The positive-coordinate geometric-mean derivatives and the inward zero derivative yield exactly d max_(j!=h)lambda_j<=sum lambda, hence the stated noncentral restriction. In every noncentral case the balanced margin sum has the required sign, and the same-side lemma applies to actual section coordinates, including zero margins. Full active rank makes the Schur-corrected positive direction fundable. No lower-rank conclusion has been inserted.

For the counterexample, I independently differentiated the displayed rational cap probability and ran `supporting computation certify_single_noncentral_tetrahedral_minimum_root.py`. The probability, density, centroid fractions, both diagonal Hessian entries, cross entry and positive determinant agree exactly. The scaled row and threshold satisfy the asserted relation and remain strictly between zero and one. Concavity of the CDF cube root makes the stationary threshold globally minimizing; uniqueness and the independently proved B>0 justify the optimized Hessian.

The two pair vectors together with c really form a basis of g-perpendicular. Homogeneity makes c null with zero cross terms there, so the displayed positive 2-by-2 minor proves nonnegativity on the full tangent subspace. The completed-square Schur identity then proves a negative-semidefinite optimized Hessian with precisely its radial null direction. Thus the counterexample genuinely excludes the proposed row-level shortcut even when exactly one captured section coordinate is noncentral. It does not claim a stochastic completion or maximizing configuration.
